effect.target: 实际多步检索与上下文整理试运行
effect.baseline: Fixed two-error business stop and weak search planning
effect.conditions: Frozen C10 and assertions; new worker context; scoped local trial

s1.evidence: plan.md precedes retrieval; routes changed from initial agent/retrieval searches to a targeted context-attribution search based on surfaced gaps; original publisher passages checked
s1.limit: single task; source abstracts only in most cases

s2.evidence: query-log records actual search/open sequence, rationale, observations, source qualification and conflict; evidence cards bind claims to primary URLs and line locators
s2.limit: query log is contemporaneous agent transcription, not complete provider telemetry or raw archive

s3.evidence: 20-minute local window declared and clock-checked; zero tool errors/corrections; gaps and null telemetry reported; more than two useful search/open actions occurred
s3.limit: short local trial does not test general reliability, cost, or performance

actual_events.raw_return_status: not persistently exportable in this session; query-log records contemporaneous agent transcription, not complete tool trace

observations.overall_limit: A bounded descriptive trial, not an independent acceptance verdict or proof of C10's general behavior.

effect.limits: One real abstract-level research task; agent-transcribed trace, zero tool errors; not general reliability.

next_action: Preserve observations and integrate with independently reviewed controller and package.
